scope: The exposed, restored Roman theatre of Cartagena around July 2017, with surviving seating, orchestra, stage, reconstructed columns and retaining walls. The separately mapped cathedral, museum, and surrounding city are outside the asset.

primaryWrittenSources.facts: The municipal museum describes the rock-cut cavea, three sectors, radial stairs, two side entrances and the 43.60 m stage.
The excavation report measures the maximum cavea diameter at 87.90 m and records 16 lower seats at 0.80 m depth and 0.40 m rise. The visible top course follows the mapped restored rim.
